\sphinxAtStartPar
Django Forms Module for Expense Tracking Application.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This module contains all form classes used for data input and validation
in the expense tracking system.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Forms Included:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
categoryForm: ModelForm for creating/editing expense categories

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
ExpenseForm: ModelForm for recording expense amounts

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
CycleForm: Standard Form for budget cycle configuration

\end{itemize}

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Each form handles specific validation rules and user input processing
for different parts of the application.

Bases: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{ModelForm}}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Form for creating and editing expense categories.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This ModelForm handles category creation with automatic user assignment.
The ‘user’ field is excluded because it’s set automatically from the
request object in the view, preventing users from assigning categories
to other users.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Features:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Automatic user assignment in view layer

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Supports icon image upload

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Enforces unique category names per user

\end{itemize}

\end{description}
\subsubsection*{Example}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{g+gp}{\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{} }\PYG{n}{form} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{categoryForm}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{request}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{POST}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{request}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{FILES}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{g+gp}{\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{} }\PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n}{form}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{is\PYGZus{}valid}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{g+gp}{... }    \PYG{n}{category} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{form}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{save}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{commit}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{g+gp}{... }    \PYG{n}{category}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{user} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{request}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{user}
\PYG{g+gp}{... }    \PYG{n}{category}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{save}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Note:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The user field is explicitly excluded to prevent tampering.
Always use commit=False and assign the user from request.user.
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Bases: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{ModelForm}}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Form for creating new expense transactions.

\sphinxAtStartPar
A simplified ModelForm that only captures the expense amount.
Other fields (user, cycle, category, timestamp) are set automatically
by the view based on the current request context and user selections.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Why only amount?:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Category is selected separately in the template dropdown

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
User comes from request.user

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cycle comes from active budget cycle

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Timestamp is auto\sphinxhyphen{}set by the model

\end{itemize}

\end{description}
\subsubsection*{Example}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{g+gp}{\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{} }\PYG{n}{form} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{ExpenseForm}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{request}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{POST}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{g+gp}{\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{} }\PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n}{form}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{is\PYGZus{}valid}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{g+gp}{... }    \PYG{n}{expense} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{form}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{save}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{commit}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{False}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{g+gp}{... }    \PYG{n}{expense}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{user} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{request}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{user}
\PYG{g+gp}{... }    \PYG{n}{expense}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{category} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{selected\PYGZus{}category}
\PYG{g+gp}{... }    \PYG{n}{expense}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{cycle} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{active\PYGZus{}cycle}
\PYG{g+gp}{... }    \PYG{n}{expense}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{save}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Note:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Only the ‘amount’ field is exposed to users. All other fields
are populated automatically in the view based on the current
session and user selections.
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Form for creating and updating budget spending cycles.

\sphinxAtStartPar
A standard Django Form (not a ModelForm) that collects budget cycle
parameters from the user. This form is used to initialize or modify
the user’s spending cycle, with start/end dates calculated server\sphinxhyphen{}side.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Why not a ModelForm?:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
start\_date and end\_date are calculated, not user input

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
is\_active is set programmatically

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Only allowance and duration are needed from users

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Form Fields:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
total\_allowance (Decimal): User’s total budget for the cycle
duration\_days (Integer): Length of the budget cycle in days

\sphinxlineitem{Validation Rules:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
total\_allowance: Minimum \$0.01, maximum 10 digits with 2 decimal places

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
duration\_days: Between 1 and 365 days (inclusive)

\end{itemize}

\end{description}
\subsubsection*{Example}

\PYG{g+gp}{\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{} }\PYG{k}{if} \PYG{n}{form}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{is\PYGZus{}valid}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{:}
\PYG{g+gp}{... }    \PYG{n}{allowance} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{form}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{cleaned\PYGZus{}data}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{total\PYGZus{}allowance}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}
\PYG{g+gp}{... }    \PYG{n}{days} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{form}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{cleaned\PYGZus{}data}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{l+s+s1}{duration\PYGZus{}days}\PYG{l+s+s1}{\PYGZsq{}}\PYG{p}{]}

\PYG{g+gp}{... }    \PYG{n}{end\PYGZus{}date} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{start\PYGZus{}date} \PYG{o}{+} \PYG{n}{timedelta}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{days}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{days} \PYG{o}{\PYGZhy{}} \PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{g+gp}{... }        \PYG{n}{total\PYGZus{}allowance}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{n}{allowance}\PYG{p}{,}

\sphinxAtStartPar
This is a standard Form, not a ModelForm, because the Cycle model
contains calculated fields (start\_date, end\_date) that are derived
from these inputs rather than collected directly from users.
The one\sphinxhyphen{}year maximum (365 days) encourages regular budget reviews.
\end{sphinxadmonition}
\index{total\_allowance (expensesApp.froms.CycleForm attribute)@\spxentry{total\_allowance}\spxextra{expensesApp.froms.CycleForm attribute}}

{\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{total\_allowance}}}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Total budget amount for the spending cycle.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This is the maximum amount the user can spend during the budget cycle.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Validation Rules:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Maximum 10 digits total (e.g., 9,999,999.99)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Maximum 2 decimal places (cents precision)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Minimum value: \$0.01 (prevents zero or negative budgets)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Must be a positive decimal number

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Example valid values:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
500.00 (Five hundred dollars)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
1000.50 (One thousand dollars and fifty cents)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
250.75 (Two hundred fifty dollars and seventy\sphinxhyphen{}five cents)

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Example invalid values:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
0.00 (Too low \sphinxhyphen{} must be at least \$0.01)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxhyphen{}50.00 (Negative not allowed)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
1000.123 (Too many decimal places)

\end{itemize}

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
The value is stored as Decimal to maintain precise
monetary calculations without floating\sphinxhyphen{}point errors.

\end{fulllineitems}

\index{duration\_days (expensesApp.froms.CycleForm attribute)@\spxentry{duration\_days}\spxextra{expensesApp.froms.CycleForm attribute}}

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{expensesApp:expensesApp.froms.CycleForm.duration_days}}
\pysigstartsignatures
\pysigline
{\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{duration\_days}}}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Length of the budget cycle in days.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Determines how long the budget cycle will last from the start date.
The system automatically calculates the end date based on this value.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Validation Rules:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Minimum: 1 day (single day cycle \sphinxhyphen{} for daily budgeting)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Maximum: 365 days (one year \sphinxhyphen{} annual budget cycle)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Must be a positive integer

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{How end date is calculated:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
start\_date = current date (when form is submitted)
end\_date = start\_date + (duration\_days \sphinxhyphen{} 1)

\end{description}
\subsubsection*{Examples}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
duration\_days = 1 \(\rightarrow\) Same day cycle (ends today)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
duration\_days = 7 \(\rightarrow\) One week cycle

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
duration\_days = 30 \(\rightarrow\) Approximately one month cycle

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
duration\_days = 365 \(\rightarrow\) One year cycle

\end{itemize}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Why limit to 365 days?:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Encourages regular budget reviews

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Prevents excessively long cycles

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Aligns with annual financial planning

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Maintains data freshness

\end{itemize}

\end{description}

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Note:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Includes validation to prevent cycles longer than one year
to ensure regular budget reviews and accurate tracking.
Users can create a new cycle after the previous one ends.
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\end{fulllineitems}


\end{fulllineitems}



\subsection{expensesApp.models module}
\label{\detokenize{expensesApp:module-expensesApp.models}}\label{\detokenize{expensesApp:expensesapp-models-module}}\index{module@\spxentry{module}!expensesApp.models@\spxentry{expensesApp.models}}\index{expensesApp.models@\spxentry{expensesApp.models}!module@\spxentry{module}}

Expenses App Models Module.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This module defines the database models for the expense tracking system:
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Models Included:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cycle: Represents budget periods with spending limits and date ranges

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Category: Organizes expenses by type for better tracking

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Expense: Records individual spending transactions

\end{itemize}

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Each model includes appropriate fields, relationships, and methods
for managing personal finance data with user\sphinxhyphen{}specific filtering.

a total allowance. Each user has one active cycle at a time, which is
used to calculate spending limits and progress.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Compared against total\_expenses to track progress

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Used to calculate remaining budget

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Determines safe daily spending limits

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Calculations:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
remaining\_budget = total\_allowance \sphinxhyphen{} total\_spent
progress\_percent = (total\_spent / total\_allowance) * 100
safe\_daily\_limit = remaining\_budget / days\_remaining

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Example: 1000.00 (One thousand dollars)

\end{fulllineitems}

\index{is\_active (expensesApp.models.Cycle attribute)@\spxentry{is\_active}\spxextra{expensesApp.models.Cycle attribute}}

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{expensesApp:id9}}
\pysigstartsignatures
\pysigline
{\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{is\_active}}}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Flag indicating if this is the user’s active budget cycle.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Field Details:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Type: BooleanField (True/False)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Default: True (new cycles start as active)

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Behavior:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Only ONE cycle per user should have is\_active=True

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Active cycle is used for current expense tracking

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Inactive cycles are kept for historical data

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Users can only add expenses to the active cycle

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{State Transitions:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
New cycle created \(\rightarrow\) is\_active = True

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cycle ends (past end\_date) \(\rightarrow\) set is\_active = False

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
User creates new cycle \(\rightarrow\) old cycle becomes inactive

\end{itemize}

\end{description}
\subsubsection*{Example}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{g+gp}{\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{} }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Deactivate old cycle}
\PYG{g+gp}{\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{} }\PYG{n}{old\PYGZus{}cycle}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{is\PYGZus{}active} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{k+kc}{False}
\PYG{g+gp}{\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{} }\PYG{n}{old\PYGZus{}cycle}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{save}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{g+gp}{\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{} }\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} Create new active cycle}
\PYG{g+gp}{\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{}\PYGZgt{} }\PYG{n}{new\PYGZus{}cycle} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{Cycle}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{objects}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{create}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{p}{)}  \PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{} is\PYGZus{}active=True by default}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\end{fulllineitems}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Bases: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{Model}}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Represents an expense category for organizing spending.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Categories allow users to group their expenses by type (e.g., Food,
Transport, Entertainment, Utilities). Each category is unique per user,
meaning two users can have a “Food” category, but one user cannot have
duplicate category names.

\index{user (expensesApp.models.Category attribute)@\spxentry{user}\spxextra{expensesApp.models.Category attribute}}

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{expensesApp:id10}}
\pysigstartsignatures
\pysigline
{\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{user}}}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Foreign key to the user who owns this category.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Field Details:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Type: ForeignKey (many categories can belong to one user)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Related Model: userRegistration (custom user model)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Nullable: Yes (allows categories without user for testing)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Blank: Yes (can be empty in forms)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
On Delete: CASCADE \sphinxhyphen{} if user is deleted, their categories are deleted

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Why ForeignKey?:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Users can have multiple categories, but each category belongs
to exactly one user. This is a standard one\sphinxhyphen{}to\sphinxhyphen{}many relationship.

\end{description}
\subsubsection*{Example}

\sphinxAtStartPar
User “john” can have categories: Food, Transport, Entertainment
User “jane” can have categories: Food, Rent, Utilities
(Both can have “Food” \sphinxhyphen{} it’s independent per user)

\end{fulllineitems}

\sphinxAtStartPar

\sphinxAtStartPar

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
On Delete: CASCADE \sphinxhyphen{} if user is deleted, their expenses are deleted

\sphinxlineitem{Purpose:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Associates expense with the correct user

\sphinxAtStartPar
Enables user\sphinxhyphen{}specific expense filtering

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Ensures users only see their own expenses

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Used for user\sphinxhyphen{}specific budget calculations

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Security:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Always filter expenses by request.user in views

Never show expenses of other users

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Precision handles most real\sphinxhyphen{}world expenses

\end{itemize}

\subsubsection*{Examples}
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
4.99 (Coffee)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
45.50 (Groceries)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
1200.00 (Rent)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
25000.00 (Car purchase)

\end{itemize}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Usage in Calculations:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
total\_spent = SUM(amount) where user=X and cycle=Y

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
remaining\_budget = total\_allowance \sphinxhyphen{} total\_spent

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
today\_spent = SUM(amount) where date=today

\end{itemize}

\end{description}

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Note:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Stored as Decimal to maintain precise monetary calculations
without floating\sphinxhyphen{}point rounding errors. Always use Decimal
for financial data, never float!
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\subsection{expensesApp.urls module}
\label{\detokenize{expensesApp:module-expensesApp.urls}}\label{\detokenize{expensesApp:expensesapp-urls-module}}\index{module@\spxentry{module}!expensesApp.urls@\spxentry{expensesApp.urls}}\index{expensesApp.urls@\spxentry{expensesApp.urls}!module@\spxentry{module}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Expenses App URL Configuration.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This module defines all URL patterns for the expense tracking functionality
including expense management, category operations, budget cycle setup,
and spending analytics.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{URL Patterns Overview:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Expense Management: Add expenses, view all expenses

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Category Management: Create, edit, delete, list categories

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Budget Cycle: Set up initial budget cycle

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Analytics: Visual spending insights and charts

\end{itemize}

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
All URLs are namespaced under the expenses app and can be referenced
using the ‘name’ attribute in templates and views.
\index{urlpatterns (in module expensesApp.urls)@\spxentry{urlpatterns}\spxextra{in module expensesApp.urls}}

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{expensesApp:expensesApp.urls.urlpatterns}}

\subsection{expensesApp.views module}
\label{\detokenize{expensesApp:module-expensesApp.views}}\label{\detokenize{expensesApp:expensesapp-views-module}}\index{module@\spxentry{module}!expensesApp.views@\spxentry{expensesApp.views}}\index{expensesApp.views@\spxentry{expensesApp.views}!module@\spxentry{module}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Expenses App Views Module.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This module contains all view functions for the expense tracking application,
including expense management, category operations, budget cycle setup,
and spending analytics.

\sphinxAtStartPar
All views are protected by @login\_required decorator, ensuring only
authenticated users can access expense tracking functionality.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Views Included:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
addExpense: Handle expense creation with budget validation

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
addCategory: Create new expense categories

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
displayAllexpenses: Show all user expenses

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
setCycle: Initialize or update budget cycle

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
spendingInsights: Generate spending analytics and charts

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
category\_list: Display all user categories

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
edit\_category: Modify existing categories

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
delete\_category: Remove categories and associated expenses

\end{itemize}

\end{description}
\index{addExpense() (in module expensesApp.views)@\spxentry{addExpense()}\spxextra{in module expensesApp.views}}

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{expensesApp:expensesApp.views.addExpense}}
\pysigstartsignatures
\pysiglinewithargsret
{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{expensesApp.views.}}\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{addExpense}}}
{\sphinxparam{\DUrole{n}{request}}}
{}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Handle expense creation with comprehensive budget validation.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This view processes expense form submissions, validates against the user’s
active budget cycle, and provides real\sphinxhyphen{}time warnings for:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Budget threshold alerts (80\% and 100\% usage)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Daily safe spending limit violations

\end{itemize}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Features:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Pre\sphinxhyphen{}save validation and checks

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Budget percentage calculations (before and after save)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Threshold alerts for budget milestones

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Daily spending limit warnings

\end{itemize}

\end{description}
\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Parameters}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{request}} \textendash{} HTTP request object containing POST data with expense amount
and selected category

\sphinxlineitem{Returns}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Rendered addExpense.html template with form and categories context

\end{description}\end{quote}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Alert Conditions:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
100\% Budget: Error message when budget is exhausted

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
80\% Budget: Warning message when nearing limit

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Daily Limit: Warning when daily spending exceeds safe limit

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Process Flow:}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
GET: Display empty expense form with user’s categories

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
POST: Process expense submission
a. Validate form and category existence
b. Check for active budget cycle
c. Calculate pre\sphinxhyphen{}save budget percentage
d. Save expense
e. Calculate post\sphinxhyphen{}save budget percentage
f. Trigger alerts based on thresholds
g. Check daily spending limit
h. Display appropriate success/error messages

\end{enumerate}

\end{description}
\subsubsection*{Example}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{POST request with:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
amount: 50.00
categories: Food

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Result: Expense saved, budget alerts shown if thresholds crossed

\end{fulllineitems}

\begin{fulllineitems}

\pysigstartsignatures
\pysiglinewithargsret

{\sphinxparam{\DUrole{n}{request}}}
{}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Create or update user’s budget spending cycle (User Story 1).

\sphinxAtStartPar
Allows students to input their total cash allowance and cycle duration.
Automatically calculates start date, end date, and displays current daily
spending limit based on remaining budget.
\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Parameters}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{request}} \textendash{} HTTP request object containing POST data with:
total\_allowance: Total budget for the cycle (min \$0.01)
duration\_days: Number of days the cycle should last (1\sphinxhyphen{}365)

\sphinxlineitem{Returns}
\sphinxAtStartPar
form: CycleForm for user input
existing\_cycle: Current cycle if exists (for display)
preview\_daily\_limit: Calculated safe daily spending amount

\sphinxlineitem{Return type}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Rendered setCycle.html template with

\end{description}\end{quote}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Process:}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{GET Request:}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Check for existing cycle

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Pre\sphinxhyphen{}fill form if cycle exists

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculate preview daily limit

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Display form with current/pre\sphinxhyphen{}filled values

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxlineitem{POST Request:}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Validate form data

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculate start\_date = today

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculate end\_date = start\_date + duration\_days \sphinxhyphen{} 1

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Create new cycle OR update existing

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Set is\_active = True (deactivates any previous cycle)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Redirect to home page with success message

\end{enumerate}

\end{description}

\sphinxlineitem{Formula:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
start\_date = current date
end\_date = start\_date + duration\_days \sphinxhyphen{} 1
days\_remaining = max((end\_date \sphinxhyphen{} today).days + 1, 1)
remaining\_budget = total\_allowance \sphinxhyphen{} total\_spent
daily\_safe\_limit = remaining\_budget / days\_remaining

\end{description}
\subsubsection*{Example}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{POST request with:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
total\_allowance: 1000.00
duration\_days: 30

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Creates cycle: Jan 1 \sphinxhyphen{} Jan 30 with \$1000 budget

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Note:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
First\sphinxhyphen{}time users are redirected here after registration
due to is\_first\_login flag in user model.
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\end{fulllineitems}

Calculate total spent across all categories

Group expenses by category using values() and annotate()

\sphinxAtStartPar
Sum amounts per category

\sphinxAtStartPar
Order by highest spending first

\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculate percentage for each category

Assign distinct colors from predefined palette

Prepare data for CSS bar chart rendering

\end{enumerate}

\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Request/response middleware pipeline.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Middleware execution order:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Request \(\rightarrow\) Each middleware processes request (top to bottom)
Response ← Each middleware processes response (bottom to top)

\sphinxlineitem{Middleware Purposes:}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Security: Adds security headers, HSTS, XSS protection

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Sessions: Manages user session data and cookies

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Common: Handles URL rewriting, ETags, content negotiation

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
CSRF: Protects against cross\sphinxhyphen{}site request forgery attacks

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Authentication: Associates logged\sphinxhyphen{}in users with requests

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Messages: Handles one\sphinxhyphen{}time flash messages for user feedback

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
XFrame: Prevents clickjacking attacks (page embedding)

\end{enumerate}

\end{description}
\subsubsection*{Notes}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Order is extremely important \sphinxhyphen{} do not change unless you understand dependencies
CSRF middleware must come after SessionMiddleware
Authentication middleware must come after SessionMiddleware

\end{fulllineitems}

\sphinxlineitem{Advantages of SQLite:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Zero configuration (no database server to install)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
File\sphinxhyphen{}based, easy to backup (just copy the file)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Great for development and testing

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
No network latency

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Works on any platform

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Disadvantages:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Not suitable for high concurrency

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Limited features compared to PostgreSQL/MySQL

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Not recommended for production

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Production Recommendation:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Use PostgreSQL for production:
\begin{description}

‘NAME’: ‘expenses\_db’,
‘USER’: ‘db\_user’,
‘PASSWORD’: ‘secure\_password’,
‘HOST’: ‘localhost’,
‘PORT’: ‘5432’,

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\}

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\}

\}
\end{quote}

\}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Password validation rules.

\sphinxAtStartPar
These validators work alongside custom form validators (like the 8\sphinxhyphen{}20
character validation in registration form).

\sphinxAtStartPar
Validators enforce password strength requirements:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
UserAttributeSimilarityValidator:
\sphinxhyphen{} Prevents passwords similar to username, email, etc.
\sphinxhyphen{} Checks for common patterns and similarities
\sphinxhyphen{} Example: Password ‘john123’ for username ‘john’ would be rejected

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
MinimumLengthValidator:
\sphinxhyphen{} Enforces minimum password length (default: 8 characters)
\sphinxhyphen{} Can be customized with OPTIONS:
\begin{quote}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\{‘OPTIONS’: \{‘min\_length’: 12\}\}
\end{quote}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
CommonPasswordValidator:
\sphinxhyphen{} Blocks commonly used passwords
\sphinxhyphen{} Uses list of 20,000 common passwords
\sphinxhyphen{} Examples: ‘password123’, ‘qwerty’, ‘admin’, ‘12345678’

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
NumericPasswordValidator:
\sphinxhyphen{} Prevents entirely numeric passwords
\sphinxhyphen{} Blocks passwords like ‘12345678’ or ‘11111111’

\end{enumerate}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Custom Validator Example:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Add custom options to MinimumLengthValidator:
\{
\begin{quote}

\sphinxAtStartPar
‘NAME’: ‘django.contrib.auth.password\_validation.MinimumLengthValidator’,
‘OPTIONS’: \{‘min\_length’: 12\}
\end{quote}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\}

\end{description}

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Note:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
These validators apply to all password changes (admin, user forms).
Custom form validators (8\sphinxhyphen{}20 chars) are additional restrictions.
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\end{fulllineitems}

Organize static files for web server configuration

\sphinxlineitem{Management Command:}
\sphinxAtStartPar

\sphinxhyphen{} Copies all static files to STATIC\_ROOT directory

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{important}{Important:}\begin{itemize}

\sphinxAtStartPar

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Do NOT commit this directory to version control

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Web server should point to this directory for static files

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Should be excluded in .gitignore: ‘staticfiles/’

\end{itemize}
\end{sphinxadmonition}
\begin{description}

\}

\subsection{softwareProject.urls module}
\label{\detokenize{softwareProject:module-softwareProject.urls}}\label{\detokenize{softwareProject:softwareproject-urls-module}}\index{module@\spxentry{module}!softwareProject.urls@\spxentry{softwareProject.urls}}\index{softwareProject.urls@\spxentry{softwareProject.urls}!module@\spxentry{module}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Main Project URL Configuration for softwareProject.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This module defines the top\sphinxhyphen{}level URL patterns for the entire expense tracking
application. It routes incoming requests to appropriate app\sphinxhyphen{}level URL
configurations and serves static/media files during development.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{The \sphinxtitleref{urlpatterns} list routes URLs to views. For more information please see:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxurl{https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/6.0/topics/http/urls/}

\sphinxlineitem{URL Structure:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
/admin/          \sphinxhyphen{} Django admin interface
/register/       \sphinxhyphen{} User registration (from register\_login)
/login/          \sphinxhyphen{} User login (from register\_login)
/logout/         \sphinxhyphen{} User logout (from register\_login)
/addExpense/     \sphinxhyphen{} Add new expense (from expensesApp)
/categories/     \sphinxhyphen{} Manage categories (from expensesApp)
/setCycle/       \sphinxhyphen{} Budget cycle setup (from expensesApp)
/insights/       \sphinxhyphen{} Spending insights (from expensesApp)
/home/           \sphinxhyphen{} Main dashboard

\end{description}
\subsubsection*{Examples}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Function views:}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Add import: from my\_app import views

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Add URL: path(‘’, views.home, name=’home’)

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxlineitem{Class\sphinxhyphen{}based views:}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Add import: from other\_app.views import Home

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Add URL: path(‘’, Home.as\_view(), name=’home’)

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxlineitem{Including another URLconf:}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Import include(): from django.urls import include, path

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Add URL: path(‘blog/’, include(‘blog.urls’))

\end{enumerate}

\end{description}


\subsection{softwareProject.views module}
\label{\detokenize{softwareProject:module-softwareProject.views}}\label{\detokenize{softwareProject:softwareproject-views-module}}\index{module@\spxentry{module}!softwareProject.views@\spxentry{softwareProject.views}}\index{softwareProject.views@\spxentry{softwareProject.views}!module@\spxentry{module}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Main Application Views Module.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This module contains the core views for the root application, including
the main dashboard/home page that displays budget overview, spending
metrics, and daily spending limits for authenticated users.
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Key Features:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Budget cycle overview and status

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Safe daily limit calculation (server\sphinxhyphen{}side)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Spending progress tracking with percentage

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Daily spending alerts

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Cycle status monitoring (active, ended, overspent)

\end{itemize}

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
All views are protected by @login\_required decorator to ensure only
authenticated users can access the dashboard.
\index{home() (in module softwareProject.views)@\spxentry{home()}\spxextra{in module softwareProject.views}}

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{softwareProject:softwareProject.views.home}}
\pysigstartsignatures
\pysiglinewithargsret
{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{softwareProject.views.}}\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{home}}}
{\sphinxparam{\DUrole{n}{request}}}
{}
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Main dashboard view displaying user’s budget cycle status and spending metrics.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This view serves as the primary dashboard for authenticated users, showing
real\sphinxhyphen{}time budget information including total spent, remaining budget,
safe daily limit, and spending progress. All calculations are performed
server\sphinxhyphen{}side with no JavaScript required for maximum compatibility and security.
\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Parameters}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{request}} \textendash{} HTTP request object from authenticated user

\sphinxlineitem{Returns}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Rendered main.html template with comprehensive budget context data

\end{description}\end{quote}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Formula Calculations:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
total\_spent = SUM(expense.amount) for current cycle
remaining\_budget = total\_allowance \sphinxhyphen{} total\_spent
days\_remaining = MAX((end\_date \sphinxhyphen{} today).days + 1, 1)
safe\_daily\_limit = remaining\_budget / days\_remaining
progress\_percent = MIN((total\_spent / total\_allowance) * 100, 100)

\sphinxlineitem{Status Definitions:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
‘no\_cycle’: User has no active budget cycle configured

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
‘active’: Cycle is within date range and budget not exceeded

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
‘ended’: Current date is past cycle end date

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
‘overspent’: Total spending has exceeded total allowance

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Alert Conditions:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Shows warning when today\_spent \textgreater{} safe\_daily\_limit (exceeds daily limit)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Shows “Cycle Ended” message when today \textgreater{} end\_date

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Shows “Budget Exceeded” message when remaining\_budget \textless{} 0

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Shows setup prompt when no cycle exists

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Context Variables:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
cycle (Cycle/None): Current active budget cycle object
safe\_daily\_limit (Decimal/None): Recommended daily spending limit
total\_spent (Decimal): Total amount spent in current cycle
remaining\_budget (Decimal/None): Budget remaining after expenses
days\_remaining (int/None): Number of days left in cycle (minimum 1)
progress\_percent (int): Percentage of budget used (0\sphinxhyphen{}100)
status (str): Cycle status \sphinxhyphen{} ‘active’, ‘ended’, ‘overspent’, ‘no\_cycle’
today\_spent (Decimal): Total amount spent today
over\_daily\_limit (bool): Whether today’s spending exceeds safe limit

\sphinxlineitem{Example Output:}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{If user has a \$1000 budget for 30 days and spent \$200:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
total\_spent = 200.00
remaining\_budget = 800.00
days\_remaining = 25 (assuming 5 days passed)
safe\_daily\_limit = 32.00 (800 / 25)
progress\_percent = 20\%
status = ‘active’

\end{description}

\sphinxlineitem{Security:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
@login\_required ensures only authenticated users can access

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Each user only sees their own data via request.user filtering

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
No sensitive data exposed to unauthenticated users

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Performance Notes:}\begin{itemize}
\item {} \begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Two database queries maximum:}\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Get active cycle

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Sum of expenses for cycle

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Sum of today’s expenses (included in same query pattern)

\end{enumerate}

\end{description}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Uses aggregation for efficient database operations

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Decimal operations for precise monetary calculations

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Template Usage:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\{\{ cycle.start\_date \}\} \sphinxhyphen{} Cycle start date
\{\{ cycle.end\_date \}\} \sphinxhyphen{} Cycle end date
\{\{ cycle.total\_allowance \}\} \sphinxhyphen{} Total budget amount
\{\{ total\_spent \}\} \sphinxhyphen{} Amount spent so far
\{\{ remaining\_budget \}\} \sphinxhyphen{} Budget remaining
\{\{ safe\_daily\_limit \}\} \sphinxhyphen{} Recommended daily spending limit
\{\{ progress\_percent \}\} \sphinxhyphen{} Progress bar percentage
\{\{ today\_spent \}\} \sphinxhyphen{} Today’s spending total
\{\{ over\_daily\_limit \}\} \sphinxhyphen{} Warning flag for excess daily spending
\{\{ status \}\} \sphinxhyphen{} Current cycle status

\sphinxlineitem{Conditional Display Examples:}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{\{\% if status == ‘no\_cycle’ \%\}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\textless{}a href=”\{\% url ‘setCycle’ \%\}”\textgreater{}Set up your budget cycle\textless{}/a\textgreater{}

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\{\% endif \%\}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{\{\% if over\_daily\_limit \%\}}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{\textless{}div class=”alert alert\sphinxhyphen{}warning”\textgreater{}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
⚠️ You’ve exceeded your daily safe limit!

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\textless{}/div\textgreater{}

\end{description}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\{\% endif \%\}
\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{\{\% if status == ‘overspent’ \%\}}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{\textless{}div class=”alert alert\sphinxhyphen{}danger”\textgreater{}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
❌ You have exceeded your budget!

\end{description}

\textless{}/div\textgreater{}
